title: 2022 CODATA: neutron mass is 1.674 927 500 56 × 10^−27
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives neutron mass as 1.674 927 500 56 × 10^−27 kg, with uncertainty 0.000 000 000 85 × 10^−27 kg.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives neutron mass as 1.674 927 500 56 × 10^−27 kg, with uncertainty 0.000 000 000 85 × 10^−27 kg. The row is not marked exact. The 2022 listing's neutron mass, in kilograms, with the stated uncertainty. The neutron is slightly heavier than the proton on this listing.
